output.text:
I fixed the blurry chart in `src/chart.js:10`. I haven't seen it running in a browser, so please reload the page on your laptop to check that it's sharp.

**Why it was blurry:** the chart is drawn as an image that's 640×320 pixels. Your laptop screen is high-resolution and Windows scales everything up, typically to 150% or 200%. That means the browser has to stretch those 640×320 pixels over more physical pixels than they have, which blurs them. Your work monitor isn't scaled, so the image fits one-to-one and stays sharp.

**The fix:** `drawChart` now checks how much the screen is scaled and draws the chart at that higher resolution. For example, at 200% it draws at 1280×640 while the chart still appears 640×320 on the page. The layout and padding values are unchanged, so it looks the same everywhere, just sharper on your laptop.

If you drag the browser window from your laptop screen to a monitor with different scaling, the chart won't redraw by itself; a page reload will fix it.
